build.buildCommand: rm -rf .next/cache/webpack && npm run build && echo '[BUILD-DEBUG] app-build-manifest:' && node -e "const f='.next/app-build-manifest.json';if(!require('fs').existsSync(f)){console.log('FILE NOT FOUND');process.exit(0);}const m=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(f,'utf8'));const keys=Object.keys(m);console.log('Total keys:',keys.length);keys.slice(0,20).forEach(k=>console.log(k,'->',JSON.stringify(m[k]).slice(0,120)));" 2>&1 || true

deploy.startCommand: npm run db:migrate:deploy && npm run start
